title: SecB Skill Candidate (WP1 deliverable 5)
description: Formalizes SECB-FAIL-LEARN-001 section 10 (Skill formation, S0..S3) as strict JSON Schema. Matrix row 4: positive proof 'Manifest and tests compile'; negative proof 'Undeclared side effect or permission rejects'. WP1 authors the CONTRACT SHAPE across the whole S0..RETIRED lifecycle so lineage/precondition rules are expressible, but WP1 does NOT implement Skill Foundry, evaluation execution, security review, or promotion (WP7/WP8, explicitly prohibited for this dispatch) -- fields like evaluation_evidence_refs, security_review_ref, checker_actor_id are contract slots a later work package populates and enforces at runtime; here they are only schema-required to be present/non-empty at the right maturity_state. LIMITATIONS deferred to semantic-validator.mjs: (1) whether any tests.*.observed_side_effects, observed_tools, observed_mcp_servers, observed_filesystem_paths, observed_network_hosts, or permission_class value is genuinely outside capability_manifest.declared_permissions -- all SIX declared_permissions categories, symmetrically, as of rework round 02 (SEC-FL-WP1-001) (validateNoUndeclaredSideEffectsOrPermissions, SCEN-10 / matrix row 4); (2) whether knowledge_maturity_at_binding honestly reflects the referenced Knowledge Artifact's real maturity_state, including the deprecated-knowledge case (validateNoDerivationFromDeprecatedKnowledge, SCEN-14); (3) full evidence/experience/knowledge/evidence lineage-chain resolution (validateFullLineageTraceability, SCEN-13); (4) checker_actor_id vs builder_identity.actor_id separation-of-duties (validateSkillProducerCheckerSeparation); (5) whether scope.tenant_id genuinely matches the cited Knowledge Artifact's (and, when supplied, its lineage's) scope -- added rework round 02 (REV-001) (validateTenantLineageConsistency, SCEN-05).

scope.description: Added rework round 02 (REV-001): a Skill Candidate is itself a tenant-scoped record, not merely a document that transitively inherits scope through its knowledge_ref -- the schema previously had no field here at all, which REV-001 found to contradict common.schema.json's tenant_scope $def description outright ('derived records (Experience/Knowledge/Skill) declare the SAME tenant_id as the evidence they cite'). semantic-validator.mjs's validateTenantLineageConsistency now genuinely cross-checks this against the referenced Knowledge Artifact (and, when supplied, its own experience/evidence lineage) -- see run-validation.mjs's runSemanticChecks.

knowledge_maturity_at_binding.description: Producer's claim about the referenced Knowledge Artifact's maturity_state at the moment this Skill Candidate was minted. Section 10: knowledge becomes a Skill Candidate only from verified (K1) knowledge. Schema forces the claim itself to be K1 (structural); semantic-validator.mjs cross-checks the claim against the actual referenced document to catch a lie (SCEN-09, SCEN-14).

declared_permissions.description: Least-privilege skill manifest (section 8). credentials is always maxItems:0 -- a Skill Candidate may never declare direct credential access at WP1 design stage; broker-mediated credential use is a separate, not-yet-designed contract.

provenance.description: Light in-toto/SLSA-styled shape (source-validation doc item 7). Not a real attestation verifier -- WP1 shape only.

test_case_allow_capable.description: Added rework round 02 (SEC-FL-WP1-001): observed_tools/observed_mcp_servers/observed_filesystem_paths/observed_network_hosts are required siblings of observed_side_effects/permission_class, one per remaining declared_permissions category, so all six categories are symmetrically observable and checkable -- previously only two of six had any 'observed' counterpart at all.

test_case_deny_only.description: SCEN-11: negative/policy-denial cases must remain fail-closed -- expected_result cannot ever be ALLOW here, closed at the enum level regardless of maturity_state. Added rework round 02 (SEC-FL-WP1-001): same observed_tools/observed_mcp_servers/observed_filesystem_paths/observed_network_hosts fields as test_case_allow_capable, for the same reason.

allOf.description: SCEN-09 / matrix row 4: promotion beyond S0 requires evaluation evidence (G4/G3 gate inputs). S0 itself (isolated sandbox candidate, section 4) does not require it yet.
SUSPENDED/ROLLED_BACK/RETIRED are only reachable from a skill that reached at least S1 (see data/maturity-transition-table.json) so they too require evaluation evidence on record.
